'''(Frederick) Geoffrey Nethersole Cloke''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] is a British [[chemist]], and professor at [[University of Sussex]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sussex.ac.uk/profiles/510|title=Geoff Cloke : University of Sussex}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sussex.ac.uk/lifesci/people/chemistry/person/510|title = Geoff Cloke : Chemistry : ... : School of Life Sciences : University of Sussex}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
*1988 [[Corday-Morgan Prize]] of the [[Royal Institute of Chemistry]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/CordayMorganPrizes/PreviousWinners.asp|title=RSC Corday-Morgan Prize Previous Winners|publisher=[[Royal Society of Chemistry]]|accessdate=9 October 2014}}</ref>
*1998 [[Tilden Prize]] of the [[Royal Institute of Chemistry]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/TildenPrizes/PreviousWinners.asp|title=RSC Tilden Prize Previous Winners|accessdate=18 February 2018}}</ref>
*2007 Elected [[Fellow of the Royal Society]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://royalsociety.org/people/geoffrey-cloke-11238/|title=Geoffrey Cloke - Biography|publisher= Royal Society|accessdate = 18 February 2018}}</ref>
